Name: Direction Selection
Description: Specifies how the sun direction is determined for lighting calculations.

Flubs.Name: Manual
Flubs.Description: Allows manual input of sun direction parameters such as azimuth and elevation.

Flubs.Name: Geographic
Flubs.Description: Calculates sun direction based on geographic coordinates, date, and time for physically accurate lighting.

Name: North
Description: Sets the orientation of the north direction in the scene, affecting geographic sun calculations.

Name: Latitude
Description: Specifies the latitude for geographic sun calculations, influencing sun position and lighting angle.

Name: Day of Year
Description: Sets the day of the year for geographic sun calculations, affecting seasonal sun position and lighting.

Name: Solar Hour
Description: Specifies the time of day for geographic sun calculations, determining the sun's position in the sky.

Name: Sun Azimuth
Description: Sets the horizontal angle of the sun, determining the direction from which sunlight is cast.

Name: Sun Elevation
Description: Controls the vertical angle of the sun above the horizon, affecting the length and intensity of shadows.

Name: Angular Diameter
Description: Specifies the apparent size of the sun in the sky, influencing the softness of shadows and highlights.

Name: Direct Light
Description: Adjusts the intensity of direct sunlight in the scene, affecting brightness and shadow contrast.

Name: Shadows
Description: Enables or adjusts the rendering of shadows cast by terrain features, enhancing depth and realism.

Name: Ambient Light
Description: Controls the overall ambient light level, simulating indirect illumination from the sky and environment.

Name: Ambient Occlusion
Description: Enables or adjusts ambient occlusion, which darkens crevices and areas shielded from ambient light for added realism.

Name: Quality
Description: Sets the rendering quality for lighting and shadow calculations.

Flubs.Name: Low
Flubs.Description: Fastest rendering with basic lighting and shadow detail.

Flubs.Name: Medium
Flubs.Description: Balanced quality and performance with moderate lighting and shadow detail.

Flubs.Name: High
Flubs.Description: High-quality rendering with detailed lighting and shadows.

Flubs.Name: Ultra
Flubs.Description: Maximum quality with the most accurate lighting and shadow effects.

Name: Light
Description: Adjusts the exposure level, controlling the overall brightness and dynamic range of the rendered image.

Name: Exposure
Description: Adjusts the exposure level, controlling the overall brightness and dynamic range of the rendered image.

Name: Sun Intensity
Description: Sets the strength of the sun's light, affecting the brightness of direct illumination.

Name: Ambient Intensity
Description: Controls the strength of ambient light, influencing the brightness of areas not directly lit by the sun.

Name: Air Density
Description: Simulates atmospheric density, affecting the scattering of light and the appearance of haze.

Name: Haze
Description: Adds atmospheric haze to the scene, softening distant terrain and simulating light diffusion.

Name: Ozone
Description: Adjusts the ozone level in the atmosphere, influencing the color and intensity of sunlight.

Name: Colors
Description: Enables automatic adjustment of sun and ambient colors based on sun position and atmospheric conditions.

Name: Automatic Colors
Description: Enables automatic adjustment of sun and ambient colors based on sun position and atmospheric conditions.

Name: Sun Color
Description: Sets the color of direct sunlight, allowing for warm, cool, or custom lighting effects.

Name: Ambient Color
Description: Specifies the color of ambient light, affecting the overall tone of shaded areas.

Name: Ground Brightness
Description: Controls the brightness of the ground plane, influencing the overall illumination and visual balance of the scene.
